info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Careers Applications Referrals-v4-spec
info.description: The Career Applications Referral Listing API provides a robust mechanism for retrieving referral data related to job applications within an organization. This endpoint allows users, such as HR professionals and recruitment teams, to access a comprehensive list of referrals submitted for various job positions. Typical use cases include analyzing referral sources, tracking candidate progress, and managing recruitment effectiveness. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their hiring processes and improve candidate engagement through effective referral management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all referral applications from the system. You can use this to view the details and status of each application.
